title: Fettuccine with Lemon Butter and Charred Zucchini Carpaccio
subtitle: with sage and Parmesan
description: Fettuccine tossed in a sage and lemon butter sauce with paper-thin roasted zucchini and plenty of Parmesan.

steps.text: Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions.
Place the butter, lemon zest, sage leaves, salt and water in a cold pan and melt everything together over low heat.
Slice the zucchini as thinly as possible, season with olive oil and salt and roast in the oven at 220°C for 15 minutes or until browned. Add to the pan.
Add the pasta to the pan and toss with the sauce over high heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until no liquid is left when you shake the pan and the sauce clings to the pasta.
Transfer to a bowl and add the grated Parmesan.
